headline: Nigeria Debt Servicing Consumes 91% of Revenue in Q1
summary: Debt servicing swallowed 91% of Nigeria's government revenue as total revenue dipped 44% to N5.08 trillion in the first quarter of 2026.
why: High debt-service-to-revenue ratios limit sovereign fiscal flexibility and increase default risk concerns for emerging market bond investors.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: High debt servicing relative to revenue constrains government expenditure and creditworthiness.
